units.prompt: Rebuild ONE complete production transparent PIXEL game token. Do not default to template's walking pose: grounded/braced feet or original lunging as equipment/action warrants, varied lead foot, uncrossed coherent limbs. Complete exact original weapons with logical handgrips; no weapons borrowed from INPUT2. Full silhouette and ALL weapon/banner/antler tips inside INNER80percent canvas. Body center ignores equipment. Transparent background, no base/floor/shadow/scenery/text/watermark/extra figures. Character identity: 무즈구르 (muzgur). EXACT original loadout/palette/materials/action from INPUT1. Five anatomical heads crown-to-sole, helmet/crown not skull. Face fully hooded, exact original dark armored/robed silhouette and original staff/sword, no invented gear.
